DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 登録変更のご相談ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to discuss changing your registration, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: メールに出る名前を変えました。銀行の氏名も自動で変わっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: メール表示名で銀行氏名も変わるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I changed the name displayed in my emails. Has my name at the bank changed automatically too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether changing your email display name also changes your bank-registered name. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: メールの表示と銀行の登録は別に確認します。何の変更をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will check your email display separately from your bank registration. What change would you like to make?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 実際に氏名が変わりました。表示名を編集しただけで手続き済みと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 実際の氏名変更と未手続きの誤解を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: My actual name has changed. I thought editing the display name alone meant the procedure was complete.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain your actual name change and misunderstanding that the procedure was already done. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 必要な資料を担当が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: The staff member will check the necessary documents.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 変更を示す書類を持っています。画面のニックネームを本人確認資料の代わりにはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 変更書類を示し表示名で代用しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have documents showing the change. I will not use the on-screen nickname as a substitute for identity documents.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the name-change documents and do not substitute a display name. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 書類と登録情報を照合します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will compare the documents with your registered information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 受取メールが来るから変更完了とも考えず、氏名変更の受付結果を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: メール受信と変更完了を分け結果確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will not assume receiving emails means the change is complete either. I want to check the result of the name-change request.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish receiving email from completion of the change and ask to check the result. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 手続きが必要かも含めて案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will explain whether a procedure is necessary as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。メール表示と正式な氏名を分けて示し、必要な手順と結果の確認方法を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 正式氏名で手順と確認方法を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I will show my email display and official name separately and ask about the necessary steps and how to confirm the result.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask about the procedure and confirmation method using your official name. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will direct you to the staff member.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 商品の表示についてお尋ねですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about the product label?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 要冷蔵は、食べる前だけ冷やす意味と思いました。今日は長く持ち歩きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 要冷蔵を食前だけ冷やす意味と思ったと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I thought 'keep refrigerated' meant cooling it only before eating. I will be carrying it around for a long time today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you thought 'keep refrigerated' meant chilling only before eating. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その解釈だけで持ち歩かず、商品の保管条件を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please check the product's storage conditions rather than carry it based only on that interpretation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 冷やす時点の話だけではなかったのですね。買った後の保管について聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 購入後の保管説明を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: So it was not just about when to chill it. I would like to ask about storage after purchase.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask for an explanation of storage after purchase. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 表示と持帰り条件を担当に確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can check the label and taking-home conditions with the staff member.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 買い物後は二時間ほかへ寄る予定です。店を出たらすぐ冷蔵できると説明しないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 寄り道時間と即冷蔵不可を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I plan to stop elsewhere for two hours after shopping. I will not say I can refrigerate it as soon as I leave the shop.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain the two-hour stop and that immediate refrigeration is impossible. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その予定を含めて相談してください。ここで保管の安全を保証はしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please include that plan in your discussion. We cannot guarantee storage safety here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 自分の予定を先に見直します。保管条件を確認できなければ、寄り道後に買いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 予定を見直し条件不明なら後購入を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will review my plans first. If I cannot confirm the storage conditions, I would like to buy it after my other errands.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Review your plans and choose to buy later if conditions remain unclear. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 購入を後にすることもできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can postpone the purchase too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は今買わず、用事を済ませてから表示と持帰りを確認して選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 用事後に条件確認して購入すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not buy it now today. After my errands, I will check the label and how to take it home before choosing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will check the conditions and buy after your errands. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では商品を戻しておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then we will put the product back.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 自転車の返却についてですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this about returning the bicycle?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この出口から帰るので、ここへ置けば返却になると思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 出口へ置けば返却と思ったと尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am leaving through this exit, so I thought leaving it here would count as returning it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about your assumption that leaving it at the exit counts as a return. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 出口と返却場所は別です。貸出時の案内を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: The exit and return point are separate. Let us check the instructions from when you rented it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 返却の場所を書いた紙があります。出口だけで決めていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 貸出紙で正式返却先を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have the paper showing the return point. I was deciding based only on the exit.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Check the official return point using the rental paper. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 返却先はこの窓口です。ご利用時間も確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: The return point is this counter. Please also check your rental time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 窓口へ戻る時間を残していませんでした。出口へ置いて期限内に返したとは言いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 戻る時間不足と未返却を認める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I did not leave time to get back to the counter. I will not claim I returned it before the deadline by leaving it at the exit.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Acknowledge insufficient time to return and that it is not yet returned. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今からの経路と、遅れそうな場合の連絡先を案内できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: We can explain the route from here and whom to contact if you expect to be late.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。返却先へ戻る経路を聞き、間に合うと決めず状況を窓口へ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 経路と遅延連絡先を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. I will ask the route back to the return point and tell the counter my situation without assuming I will make it in time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for the route and contact for reporting a delay. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらから担当へ確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let us check with the staff member from here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。自転車を放置せず、指定先の案内を受けて返却の手続きをします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 放置せず指定先で返却手続きをする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will not abandon the bicycle. I will follow directions to the designated place and complete the return procedure.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Do not leave it unattended; complete the return at the designated place. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では窓口へ確認します。そのまま自転車を管理してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13203-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then we will check with the counter. Please keep the bicycle under your care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どちらへ向かいますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 改札です。階段が短いので、ケース二つでもこちらが楽だと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 短い階段を二荷物の近道と思ったと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: The ticket gates. The stairs are short, so I thought this would be easier even with two cases.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you thought the short stairs were a shortcut with two pieces of luggage. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 段数だけでなく、荷物を運ぶ方法も考えましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us consider how you will carry the luggage, not just the number of steps.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一人で二つを持ち上げるのは難しいです。平らな経路や昇降設備を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一人で持上げ困難と平坦経路設備を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is difficult to lift both on my own. I would like to check a level route or equipment for moving between floors.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain difficulty lifting alone and ask about level routes and lifting facilities. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 当日の使える設備を係が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: The staff member will check which facilities are usable today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 設備が近いだけで使えるとは決めず、確認を待ちます。荷物を一つ置いて往復する案もやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 設備確認を待ち荷物放置往復をやめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will not assume equipment is usable just because it is nearby; I will wait for confirmation. I will also abandon the idea of leaving one case and making two trips.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Wait for facility confirmation and do not leave luggage behind for repeated trips. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらで二つを手元に置いてお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please wait here with both cases beside you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。友人は先へ行ったので、勝手に戻って階段で運ぶよう頼まず、案内された場所で合流を相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 荷物を保持し友人との合流を指定経路で相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. My friend has gone ahead. Rather than simply asking them to come back and carry them on the stairs, I will discuss meeting at a place on the guided route.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Keep your luggage and discuss meeting your friend along the designated route. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 利用できる経路を確認できました。こちらへご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: We have confirmed an available route. We will guide you this way.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二つを一緒に管理して移動します。階段の短さより、使える経路で判断します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確認済み経路で二荷物を管理して移動する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will keep both cases together as I move. I will decide based on the usable route rather than the shortness of the stairs.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Move with both pieces of luggage under your care along the confirmed route. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、その経路へお進みください。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 新しい住所でのご生活について伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please tell me about living at the new address.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 親戚宅へ三日泊まるので、ここを転入先として書けばよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 三日宿泊を転入先にできるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I will stay at a relative's home for three days. Should I write it as my moving-in address?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether a three-day stay can be listed as moving in. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 滞在の実態と、変更したい手続きを分けて担当が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: The staff member will check the actual stay separately from the procedure you want to change.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ生活の拠点を移すと決めていません。数日の宿泊予定を伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 拠点移動未定と宿泊予定を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have not decided to move my main residence yet. I want to tell you about a stay of a few days.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that moving your main residence is undecided and describe the stay. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今の住まいについても教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please also tell us about your current home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今の家はそのままで、来週戻ります。親戚の住所を現住所として全部書き換えるつもりにはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 現住居継続と帰宅予定を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I am keeping my current home and will return next week. I do not intend to rewrite everything using my relative's address as my current residence.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: State that your present residence continues and that you plan to return. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 必要な相談先を担当が案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: The staff member will direct you to the appropriate service.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では宿泊日程と今の生活拠点を示します。親戚の了解があれば転入条件を満たすと決めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 宿泊了承と手続き条件を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I will give my stay dates and current main residence. I will not assume my relative's consent alone satisfies moving-in requirements.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish permission to stay from procedural requirements. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 状況を確認して、手続きの要否をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will check the situation and explain whether a procedure is necessary.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。短期滞在と住所の変更を分け、確認後に必要な行動を決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 滞在実態を確認し要否判断を担当に求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I will distinguish a short stay from changing address and decide the necessary action after checking.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask the staff member to assess necessity after checking the actual stay. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その内容で担当へおつなぎします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will connect you with the staff member on that basis.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どの予約を確認されたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Which appointment would you like to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 検査日を変えました。診察も同じ日に変わったと思っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 検査変更で診察も移動したと思ったと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I changed my test date. I think my consultation also moved to the same date.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you assumed changing the test also moved the consultation. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 検査と診察の予約はそれぞれ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will check the test and consultation appointments separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 検査の確認メールだけあります。診察も変更済みとは言えないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 検査だけのメールを示し診察未確認を認める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I only have the test confirmation email. So I cannot say the consultation has also been changed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the email for only the test and acknowledge the consultation is unconfirmed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 二つの予約の現在の状態を調べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will check the current status of both appointments.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 古い診察の紙も持っています。古い紙だから全部捨てず、予約の種類を分けて見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 旧診察紙を残し予約種類を分け提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I also have the old consultation paper. I will not throw everything away just because it is old; I will show the appointment types separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Keep the old consultation paper and show the appointment types separately. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当が日程と必要な準備を案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: The staff member will explain the dates and necessary preparation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 検査前の注意も、新しい日へ自分で当てはめるだけでなく確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 検査準備も新日程で確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I would also like to confirm the pre-test instructions, rather than just applying them to the new date myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask to confirm test preparation for the new schedule too. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 変更後の案内を担当から説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: The staff member will explain the instructions after the change.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。検査と診察の日、検査の準備を別にメモして確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二予約日と準備を別記録する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I will note and check the test date, consultation date, and test preparation separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Record the two appointment dates and preparation separately. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その三点を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Let us check those three points.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 最後に自転車を使ったのはどなたですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人です。返したと言ったので、いつもの置場にあると思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人使用後の不在を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: My friend. They said they returned it, so I thought it was in the usual place.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about the bicycle's absence after your friend used it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 返した場所は確認しましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you checked where they returned it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだです。友人へ聞くと別の入口に置いたそうです。いつもの場所から盗まれたとは確認できていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 返却場所が別で盗難未確認と述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. When I asked, they said they left it at a different entrance. I have not confirmed that it was stolen from the usual spot.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that it was returned elsewhere and theft is unconfirmed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 友人の説明と、現地で見た状況を分けましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us distinguish your friend's explanation from what you saw at the location.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 自分はいつもの場所だけ見ました。別入口は未確認です。場所の写真を送ってもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自分の観察範囲と別場所未確認を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I only checked the usual spot myself. The other entrance is unchecked. I will ask them to send a photo of the location.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain the extent of your own observation and that the other location is unchecked. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 写真で分かる場所を確認してから、状況を整理できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: We can organize the situation after checking the location shown in the photo.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 鍵も返してもらっていますが、鍵があるだけで車体の場所が分かるとは考えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 鍵所持と車体所在を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have received the key back too, but I will not assume having the key tells me where the bicycle is.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish possession of the key from the bicycle's location. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認後も見当たらなければ、その経過を伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: If it is still missing after checking, please tell us that sequence of events.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。友人の置場を確認し、実際に見た範囲と伝聞を分けて次の相談をします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 実地確認後に観察伝聞を分けて相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will check where my friend left it and distinguish what I actually saw from what I heard in the next consultation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: After checking the site, discuss your observations separately from hearsay. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その経過で確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Let us check along that sequence.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 提出案内を見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: May I see the submission instructions?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この日が締切なので、その日にここへ出すつもりです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 締切日に差し出す予定を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: This date is the deadline, so I plan to post it here on that day.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you plan to post it on the deadline date. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 案内には必着とあります。差出日を示す言葉とは分けて確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: The instructions say it must arrive by that date. Please distinguish that from wording about a mailing date.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 出せば期限内だと思っていました。到着が必要な日として考え直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 必着と差出日を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought posting it would put it within the deadline. I will reconsider it as the date it must arrive.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish an arrival deadline from the mailing date. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 発送方法の案内はできますが、提出先の扱いは提出先へ確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: We can explain shipping methods, but please check the submission destination's handling with them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今の方法で必ず届くと決めず、今日の差出しで選べる方法と目安を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 到着保証を決めず今日の方法目安を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will not assume the current method will definitely arrive in time. I would like to hear the options and estimates for posting today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Do not assume guaranteed arrival; ask about today's methods and estimates. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 当日の受付条件を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check today's acceptance conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 間に合うか分からなければ、提出先へ別の方法も相談します。封筒の日付だけ変えて済ませません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 不明なら提出先へ代替相談し日付改変で済ませない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: If I do not know whether it will arrive in time, I will discuss another method with the submission destination. I will not just alter the envelope date and consider it solved.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: If unsure, discuss alternatives with the destination rather than simply changing the date. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 書類の条件も確認してから選んでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also check the document requirements before choosing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。必要到着日と発送の案内を分けて確認し、提出先と相談して方法を決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 提出条件と発送案内を確認し方法を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will check the required arrival date separately from the shipping guidance and decide the method after consulting the submission destination.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check submission conditions and shipping guidance and decide a method. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では選べる発送方法をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then we will explain the available shipping methods.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 口座開設のご希望を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please tell us what account you want to open.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 夫婦で使うので、通帳に二人の名前を書いてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二人名入り口座を希望すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: My spouse and I will use it, so could you put both our names on the passbook?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you want an account with both names. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 名義と利用する方の関係を、担当が確認します。通帳へ名前を足すだけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: The staff member will check the account holder and the relationship to those using it. It is not simply adding a name to the passbook.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一人の名義へ相手の名前を追記すればよいと思っていました。利用目的から説明したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 名義追記の誤解を直し目的説明を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought we could just add the other person's name to an account in one person's name. I would like to begin by explaining the purpose.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Correct the misunderstanding about adding a name and ask to explain the purpose. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: どのような入出金を予定していますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: What deposits and withdrawals are you planning?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 家計の支払いです。二人が自由に同じカードを使えると決めず、可能な方法を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 家計目的とカード共用未確認を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Household payments. I will not assume both of us can freely use the same card; I would like to ask about available methods.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: State the household purpose and that shared card use is unconfirmed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 申込みと利用の条件を案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will explain the conditions for applying and using it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 二人の資料を混ぜて一人の書類として出さず、それぞれ分けて見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 各人資料を混ぜず提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will not mix both people's documents and submit them as one person's; I will show them separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show each person's documents without mixing them. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当が必要な確認を説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: The staff member will explain the necessary checks.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。名義と利用方法が分かってから申込みを決め、今日は相談として進めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 名義と利用条件確認後に申込を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I will decide whether to apply after learning the account holder and usage arrangements. Today I will proceed as an inquiry.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide whether to apply after checking account-holder and usage conditions. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その目的で担当へご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will direct you to the staff member for that purpose.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 価格についてのお尋ねですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a question about the price?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 先週撮った値札より高いです。この写真の値段で買えると思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 過去値札写真の価格を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: It is higher than the price tag I photographed last week. I thought I could buy it at the price in this photo.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for the price shown in an old price-tag photo. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 撮影した日と本日の売場表示を分けて確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us check the date it was photographed separately from today's shelf display.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 先週の特売とあります。今日も適用されると決めていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 特売日と当日を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: It says last week's special sale. I had assumed it still applied today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish the sale date from today. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今日の商品番号と値札を照合します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will compare today's product number with the price tag.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 写真の品と容量も同じか見たいです。日付だけ直して同じ商品とは判断しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 商品番号と容量の同一性を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I also want to see whether the volume matches the item in the photo. I will not just change the date and conclude it is the same product.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check whether the product number and volume are identical. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらが本日の表示です。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 容量も違いました。以前の写真の値段を今の品へ求めるのではなく、今日の条件で選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 別容量と認め今日条件で選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: The volume was different too. I will choose based on today's conditions rather than demand the old photo's price for this item.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Acknowledge the different volume and choose based on today's conditions. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Would you like to buy it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日の容量と価格を確認したので、この品を一つ買います。古い写真は今の価格として使いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 当日表示で一品購入する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have checked today's volume and price, so I will buy one of this item. I will not use the old photo as the current price.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Buy one item based on today's display. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、その表示の品をお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13205-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please bring the item matching that display.
